coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: P10

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- owner-guided satellite trace, not a surveyed footprint or GIS file from the project team. street_clip_exempt=true: this is a real roundabout center island, inherently ringed by the circulating roadway in DataSF's curb data -- clipping it against the generic street buffer would cut real, visible parts of the island, not a mispositioning artifact.
notes.digitized_from: Hand-traced from satellite imagery (contextily/Esri World Imagery), guided directly by the owner's own marked-up screenshot (their drawn outline extracted from the photo via ORB feature-matching/homography rather than re-estimated by eye) -- same technique used for P11/P11A.

record.notes: Center island of the real 'Mission Bay Circle' roundabout at the south end of the Mission Bay Circle/Owens St area, matching plan label P10. Landscaped with grass and trees; the roundabout's own median (P11A) and connector strip (P11) are tracked separately.
